question: Who won the 2027 Nobel Prize in Literature?

subquestions: Who won the 2027 Nobel Prize in Literature?

observations.content:
[1] Nobel Prize in Literature - Wikipedia
    https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobel_Prize_in_Literature
    The Nobel Prize in Literature, here meaning for Literature.Nobel Prize Laureates in Literature are awarded for the author's life work, but on some occasions, the Academy has singled out a specific work for particular recognition.

[2] NobelPrize.org
    https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/literature/
    The Nobel Prize in Literature 2026 was awarded to the Canadian author Anne Carson “for her bold and inventive oeuvre that, in playful dialogue with the classical tradition, has created new forms for contemporary literature.”

[3] Canadian poet Anne Carson wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature
    https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/articles/canadian-poet-anne-carson-wins-112816810.html
    The literature prize is the fourth to be announced this week, following the 2026 Nobels in medecine, physics and chemistry. Each prize this year comes with 12 million Swedish kronor (€1.07 million). The winners also receive an 18-carat gold medal and a diploma.

[4] Anne Carson wins Nobel Prize in Literature - Iceland Monitor
    https://icelandmonitor.mbl.is/news/culture_and_living/2026/10/09/anne_carson_wins_nobel_prize_in_literature/
    The Nobel Prize in Literature has been awarded 119 times between 1901 and 2026. During that period, a total of 123 individuals have received the prize, 104 men and 19 women.

[5] thoughtco.com/nobel-prize-in-literature-winners-4084778
    https://www.thoughtco.com/nobel-prize-in-literature-winners-4084778
    A List of Nobel Prize Winners in Literature - ThoughtCo.
